notes.title: Zenza s slightly confused seasonal tile-matching
notes.content: Zenza [official site] caught my eye this morning. It’s a Japanese poetry-inspired tile puzzler. Well, it’s sort of a puzzle game because it’s about matching tiles and completing boards, but there’s more of a random element than I’d like so it sits uneasily between puzzle game and zone-out-while-you-match-things game for me. … [visit site to read more]
